description:
LOCATION

Located in a rural location 3.8kms north of Castlebar with access via the L1724. The surrounding area comprises of farmlands and one off private houses. This is a peaceful private location which is just a 5 minute drive to Main Street, Castlebar with its many retail, businesses, leisure amenities and schools and less than 10 minutes by car to Mayo University Hospital. 

In a wider context, Castlebar is the business and administrative centre of Co. Mayo with a growing population in excess of 12,000.  The town is well-connected with road and rail infrastructure and on the main Westport to Dublin railway line with a number of services daily.  Castlebar is within 40 minutes’ drive of Ireland West Airport, Knock.  Castlebar offers excellent shopping, business and leisure facilities.

DESCRIPTION

The property comprises of a most impressive and substantial single storey detached 3 / 4 bedroom home extending to about 480sq.m. A most unique design and construction being built of Canadian cedar. Built about 26 years ago by the current owners and with a Canadian construction company. Constructed of cedar logs with double glazed uPVC windows under a pitched roof. Rooms proportions are larger which is added to by the high floor to ceiling heights. Timber is used throughout the property to create a warm and distinctive feel. 
 
Internally this is a truly impressive home with large open plan spaces, very high ceiling heights and extensive use of cedar logs throughout. With 3 / 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, a particular feature of the home is a self-contained former dental surgery which offers the potential to convert for a variety of purposes including extending the current residential space, separate residential annex or professional offices. 
 
The property sits on a generous plot of some  1.10 hectares (2.7 acres) with a generous front drive and a second smaller front drive and parking area.  There is a large enclosed rear garden. In addition to the main house there are a number of outbuildings including 2 sheds, one of which could be used as a garage.

·         High energy efficiency with BER of B2
·         Large site with 2 no sheds, one of which could be used as a garage
·         Has a large self-contained professional office/surgery
